newsitem.title: USA: United Tech names UT Automotive president.
newsitem.headline: United Tech names UT Automotive president.

text.p: United Technologies Corp said Thursday it named C. Scott Greer president of subsidiary UT Automotive.
Greer succeeds Norman Bodine, who has been named a senior vice president of United Technologies, the company said.
Greer and Bodine will report to United Technologies President and Chief Executive George David.
Greer, 46, was formerly president and chief operating officer of Echlin Inc, a supplier to the original equipment manufacturer and aftermarket segments of the automotive industry.
UT Automotive is a $3.1 billion supplier of electrical, electronic and interior trim systems and components to car and light truck manufacturers.
